statement: Pinned Dolphin uses wire error0 for success,4 busy,6 invalid space,7 nonresponding I2C slave and8 invalid EEPROM address. Writes of1..16 bytes receive ACK; read failures have a0xf length nibble and zero payload. This is emulator policy, not physical negative-response validation.

applicability.revision: Original/TR package source model; early Plus discriminator unknown
applicability.scope: C5 compatibility model only. No physical data, cadence, factory calibration or retail descriptor claim.
